text.L1: An expression joins numbers with operations and stands for a value.
text.L2: A common myth says you must fully calculate an expression before comparing it. Not true.
text.L3: A situation helps us write an expression: 3 samosas at 15 rupees and 2 chai at 10 rupees gives 3 × 15 + 2 × 10.
text.L4: We can compare by reasoning about parts, without full calculation.
text.L5: In 247 + 389 and 250 + 386, one part gains 3 and the other loses 3.
text.L7: For words, start with the number being changed: 12 less than 40 is 40 − 12.
text.L8: Now compare the two expressions and choose the relationship you can justify.
